safety.title: Safety Guidance
safety.subtitle: Health & Safety Guidelines — Stay Safe, Work Smart
safety.batteryTip: Never crush or burn lithium batteries; fire and chemical explosion hazard!
safety.crtTip: Handle CRT glass carefully to prevent implosion; always wear mask and goggles!
safety.cableTip: Do not burn wire insulation outdoors; toxic dioxin fumes damage your lungs!
safety.acidTip: Never use nitric acid at home to leach metal from circuit boards; causes severe skin burns!
safety.smokeTip: Desoldering or heating circuit boards generates toxic fumes; work only in ventilated areas!
safety.ppeTip: Always wear thick protective gloves and sturdy boots when sorting sharp metal scrap!
